body.problem: A project's approved design choices have no dependable identity and lifecycle across web, iOS and Android. Agents cannot reliably tell which version is active, distinguish a draft from an approved guideline, or retain prior choices while a revision is reviewed. Projects that begin before code exists also lack a clear design identity, and ambiguous platform selection or concurrent changes can cause inconsistent guidance across pages.

summary.prose: Give each project separate, durable web, iOS and Android guideline sets. Users can inspect history and activate reviewed revisions explicitly while agents retrieve the correct approved version.

nonGoals.rationale: DI1 supplies evidence and DI3 owns authoring.

nonGoals.text: Per-page guideline identities or implicit platform fallback
nonGoals.rationale: Guidelines apply across pages for a project/UI-type pair.

assumptions.text: Projects need guideline identity before a repository is available; the binding mechanism is a downstream design decision.

constraints.text: One active reviewed and explicitly approved version per project/UI-type pair; drafts, prior versions and other UI types remain isolated.
Retrieval is read-only and returns explicit missing guidance rather than a draft or wrong-platform substitute; exports preserve evidence and notices.
Daemon owns DB access through IPC; preserve repo.add registry contract and do not equate design-project creation with repository registration.

stories.title: Identify projects and their supported guideline sets
stories.userValue: Users can organize design decisions before or after code exists.

acceptanceCriteria.then: it can hold Web, Mobile-iOS and Mobile-Android sets without registering a fictional repository

functionalRequirements.statement: Identify projects and their supported guideline sets

stories.title: Save complete guideline drafts and retain history
stories.userValue: Users can inspect reusable rules and the evidence behind every revision.

acceptanceCriteria.then: foundations, reusable rules, states, exceptions, rationale and pinned evidence remain available with identity, version and draft status

acceptanceCriteria.given: a revision is saved or the daemon restarts
acceptanceCriteria.then: prior versions remain intact and the draft has not become active

functionalRequirements.statement: Save complete guideline drafts and retain history

stories.title: Activate only the exact reviewed and approved revision
stories.userValue: Users can trust the active rules even when revisions overlap.

acceptanceCriteria.given: a reviewed unchanged revision and explicit approval
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly that version becomes active for its project and UI type while prior versions remain in history

acceptanceCriteria.given: stale review, absent approval or competing revision
acceptanceCriteria.then: no unapproved or stale version activates and a conflict is reported without two active versions
the active version and history do not duplicate

functionalRequirements.statement: Activate only the exact reviewed and approved revision

stories.title: Resolve active and historical guidelines without changing them
stories.userValue: Agents reuse one dependable set across page tasks.

acceptanceCriteria.given: three pages in one project and UI type
acceptanceCriteria.then: all receive the same active version without new drafts or approval requests

acceptanceCriteria.given: no approved Android set but Web and iOS exist

acceptanceCriteria.then: its exact contents and superseded status are returned

functionalRequirements.statement: Resolve active and historical guidelines without changing them

stories.title: Export traceable guidelines while keeping projects and platforms isolated
stories.userValue: Users can share accurate guidelines and audit their lineage.

acceptanceCriteria.then: human-readable and structured outputs retain identity, version, status, provenance and required notices

acceptanceCriteria.when: mobile sets and another project are retrieved

functionalRequirements.statement: Export traceable guidelines while keeping projects and platforms isolated

requirements.statement: Users manage independent guideline history and approval for each project and UI type.
Agents receive the exact requested guideline version and status without triggering authoring.
